item.title: Local opposition over Triple Lock abolishment
item.description: A Co Monaghan councillor has expressed her opposition to the Government's proposal to abolish or amend the Triple Lock governing the overseas deployment of Irish Defence Forces personnel. Cllr Sinead Flynn believes any such attempts would be a breach of trust with the Irish people and a serious undermining of Ireland's neutrality. item.title: Monaghan Lions Club celebrates 35 years
item.description: Co Monaghan will host the 2026 Annual Lions Club Ireland Convention for the first time ever this weekend. The national convention also coincides with Monaghan Lions Club celebrating 35 years since its inception here in the Farney County. The local club is made up of 30 members from different backgrounds who raise funds for charities and organisations locally. item.title: Cavan man who smoked for 50 years encourages others to give them up
item.description: A Co Cavan man has praised the HSE Community Stop Smoking Service following giving up smoking after 50 years. Over the last number of years, Joey began having issues with his breathing and decided enough was enough, he sought help. Joey joined the free HSE Cavan Community Stop Smoking Service. item.title: Gardaí and Revenue seize cannabis valued at €125,000 in Cavan
item.description: As part of an intelligence-led operation involving the Garda National Drugs and Organised Crime Bureau (GNDOCB), Cavan Drugs Unit and the Revenue Customs Service, 6.25kg of herbal cannabis was seized today in Co Cavan. A man aged in his 30s, was arrested and is being detained in a station in the Garda North Western Region under the provisions of Section 2 of Criminal Justice (Drug Trafficking) Act 1996. item.title: 14 week average wait time for driving tests locally
item.description: The average wait time for a driving test in Cavan and Monaghan now stands at 14 weeks. The details were revealed by the Central Statistics Office this week. As of the end of February, the estimated time for a driving test invite stood at 14 weeks for both Cavan and Monaghan. The figures reveal a significant drop compared to this time last year when local learner drivers were waiting up on 20 weeks.
